Before you enter the command, decide who will be partner A & who will be partner B. You will need a drawing tool for this challenge. To begin, type !maze-pain-1a or !maze-pain-1b in your solo channel. If one of you have done this before, both of you replace the one with a two for the command. Once you do so you will be given an imgur link that contains your sections of a maze. The images will start at the top and work their way down, so person a has the start and the odd sections and person b has the finish and the even sections. When put together from top to bottom the maze is solvable. As a duo you must solve each section of the maze using a drawing tool so that if the images were all placed on each other top to bottom it would be a successfully completed maze. Some of the middle sections may have multiple paths or entrances but there is only one way to solve the maze. NO SHARING IMAGES IN YOUR 1-1 CHANNEL, obviously you can talk about it however. Partner A is responsible for solving the Partner A sections, & Partner B is responsible for solving the Partner B sections. After you solve the maze, post each section in individual messages in order from top to bottom in your solo submissions chat. The person who was responsible for solving that section must also post the solution to that section. The final image you send can only be of that section. Once you complete this challenge you may move on. Example: https://imgur.com/a/0ltY60I (In this Example Aperson is Partner A then Pilot is Partner B) Aperson: top part (Aperson would post this image first since it is the top most image & it is labeled Partner A) Pilot: bottom part (Pilot would post this image 2nd since it is the 2nd to top most image & it is labeled Partner B) In order to get this advantage you'll need a time to beat of 30 minutes.
